stem.text: A teacher removes the turntable from a microwave oven and places a bar of chocolate in the oven. She then switches the oven on for a short time.
A stationary wave is formed in the oven.
When the chocolate is removed, the teacher observes that there are two small sections of melted chocolate $6.0\,\text{cm}$ apart with unmelted chocolate in between.
Each section of melted chocolate is located at an antinode.

stem.alt: Rectangle containing two dots joined by a double-headed arrow labelled 6.0 cm; a line from the label melted chocolate points to the left dot.

stem.text: Assume that the speed of the microwaves is $3.0 \times 10^{8}\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the frequency of the microwaves emitted by the oven?
